title: Page 3
content_zh:
温宁连忙伸手去摸，结果却摸到了……一颗头，“啊！”
“不要叫，是我。”
“你……”温宁挤了挤眼，低头看到一个很模糊的轮廓，她又摸了一会，“在干嘛？”
“也不是什么大事。”肖崇源抬起身子，“吵醒你了？”
“没、没有……”他这么一抬头，温宁才觉得自己胸前凉凉的，好像是衣服被脱掉了，黑暗之中，她的小脸迅速升温，连喉咙都变得干涩，“我们……那个……”
“别紧张，你想继续睡也可以。”
她怎么睡得着！在肖崇源又要吻下来的时候，温宁忽然伸手挡住他。
“怎么了？”
“很晚了，你、你也一直在工作，不如……不如就睡觉吧？”
“我还好，不是很累。”
“可是……”
“你脸上好香。”肖崇源忽然说到这个。
温宁一愣，下意识回答道：“啊？哦，我晚上有用新的保养品，满好用的。”
肖崇源认真地点点头，“我让助理帮忙挑的，看来她眼光不错。”
“哦。”
“身上有抹东西吗？”
“没有啊，怎么了？”他们怎么聊起这个来了？
“那怎么也这么香？尤其是这里……”肖崇源说着就低头含住了她胸前的丰盈。
温宁浑身一僵，双手猛地按在肖崇源肩膀上，但怎么都没办法把他推下去，“别……”
反抗的话还没说出口，肖崇源就已经把她的手分开按在身体两边，炽热的唇沿着胸口一路往下滑。

房间里很黑，温宁什么都看不到，黑暗中挟带的不安感，令肖崇源的唇带来的感觉更加明显，未经人事的她很快就被他吻得浑身瘫软。
温宁始终都紧紧地搂着他的脖子，偶尔会忍不住呻吟出声，但一直都很小心翼翼，把脸埋在他的颈窝不敢抬头，因为她的小心和胆怯，那晚只做了两次后，肖崇源就放过了她，温柔地抱着她入睡。
像新婚之夜这样美好的夜晚，并没有持续多久，婚后不到两个月，肖崇源就开始筹办自己的医院。
虽然家底殷实，他却很排斥接手父母的产业，所以疲于打拚自己的事业，而温宁也努力地尽好妻子的本分，专心地打理家事，不让肖崇源费心。
不过肖崇源实在是太忙了，忙得几乎忘记了家里还有一位新婚妻子，所以温宁在新婚几个月之后，想见他一面变得越来越难。
结婚第五个月的某天，肖崇源已经两星期没回家了，这天上午她忍不住打了通电话给他，他说今晚会回来，可是他好像又食言了……
温宁看着一大桌的饭菜，忽然觉得鼻头泛酸，她悠悠地吐出一口气，垂头丧气地拿起了筷子，呆呆地看着琳琅满目的饭菜，不知道该吃哪个。
就在温宁犹豫不决的时候，电梯“叮”的一声响，温宁眼睛一亮，立刻放下筷子小跑到玄关处，贴心地把室内拖鞋放到门口，扬起贤慧的笑容，不过一想到自己的矫正器，她又立刻把唇抿上。
肖崇源露出了个略带疲倦的笑容，他自然地将公事包和车钥匙交给温宁，接着换鞋进屋，看都没看那桌菜，就迳自去浴室洗澡。
第1章(2)
十五分钟后肖崇源再出来，桌上的饭菜已经被温宁重新热了一遍。
“今天的工作辛苦吗？”温宁没话找话。
“还好。”肖崇源言简意赅，觉得工作上的事没必要和温宁多说。
“哦，要不要喝点红酒？”
“不了。”
“那好。”温宁转而帮他倒了一杯八分满的温水，坐到他对面，满眼期待地看着他。
他们没见面的两个星期里，她又新学了几道菜，今天特意在肖崇源面前露一手，不过他自始至终都没怎么说话，对她做的菜更是提都没提一句。
直到放下碗，肖崇源一抬眼才看到温宁一脸失望地看着自己，他抽出卫生纸擦了擦唇角，问：“怎么了？”
“没什么，吃完了？”
“嗯。”

“那我收拾了。”温宁笑了笑，起身开始收拾碗筷。
“辛苦了，我还有些工作，那么……”肖崇源对她点点头，接着去书房了。
在肖崇源离开书房之前，温宁已经睡着了，和新婚之夜一样，也和之前无数个夜晚一样，温宁被工作告一段落的肖崇源吻醒。
“等等……”温宁挡住他乱摸的手。
“怎么了？”
“我换了……”
“换了什么？”
温宁换了新的睡衣，特意给他看的，但温宁等了一整个晚上，直到睡着他都还在工作，现在虽然忙完了，但卧室里黑漆漆的什么都看不到了。
温宁顿时又觉得失落，摇了摇头说：“没什么。”
肖崇源也没再多问，低头去吻她，却被她躲开，他微有不悦，“躲什么？”
温宁满脸通红地抿着唇，“以后我们都不接吻好不好？”
肖崇源拧眉，“为什么？”
温宁吞了吞口水，“因为那个……矫正器……”她是担心会划到他的舌头啦。
肖崇源一愣，接着无奈地笑了笑，“就因为这个？”怪不得一接吻她就扭扭捏捏的。
肖崇源难得有耐心地停下正在做的事，侧躺在她身边，“为什么一直这么在意这个？我觉得这样满好的，矫正牙齿又不是坏事。”
“好丑……”
“阿宁……”肖崇源低低地笑，“不要胡思乱想，我不觉得你丑。”
“真的吗？”温宁脸一红。
“是啊，不要在意这个，多笑笑，你笑起来很漂亮。”
“哦……”温宁忍不住心花怒放。

“那么我们继续了？”
“嗯。”温宁甜甜地笑，心情大好的她居然揽住他的脖子，主动献上红唇。
方才的失落一扫而光，取而代之的是腻在心头的甜蜜，正是因为这种偶尔给予的温柔与悸动，让温宁始终对肖崇源抱有希望，始终觉得等到他的事业稳定下来，他们一定会好好地生活。
但长时间浸泡在寂寞中，让温宁渐渐不安起来，她越来越不敢肯定肖崇源对她到底是什么感情。
温宁自小就有点自卑，虽然是家里的么女，但除了长相清新、身材姣好以外，其他方面都比几个风情万种的姊姊要逊色，所以她对他们这段感情也不太有自信，更因为长久的分离而不知道该如何与他相处。
每到这个时候，温宁就总会想到那晚他说她笑起来其实很漂亮，这句话几乎成了她之后所有笑容的支撑。
婚后第八个月，温宁终于拿下了牙齿矫正器。
因为佩戴两年矫正器，她的牙齿变得整齐又洁白，两腮收拢，更显得下巴削尖。
那时温宁已经将近二十三岁，本身已经出落得清丽可人的她变得更加脱俗，最主要是她有了自信，变得爱笑，于是整个人的感觉都变了。
温宁本身性格就不内向，之前因为带了矫正器渐渐地减少人际交流，现在没了这个障碍，她开始逐渐地恢复了开朗。
温宁觉得自己变漂亮了，就该第一时间让肖崇源知道，但难得回家的肖崇源根本没注意她，每隔几周才回来一次，吃过晚饭之后就去书房工作，一直到半夜才会爬到床上把她叫醒。
温宁和肖崇源的回忆少得可怜，似乎只有在床上，她虽然有了自信，但却对两人的关系更加不安。
而时间久了，这种不安就变成了抱怨，温宁觉得肖崇源根本没有把自己当成妻子，而是厨师、清洁阿姨和暖床的工具，她执着地想知道他对她到底抱着什么态度。
content_en:
Wen Ning quickly reached out to touch it, but he touched... a head, "Ah!"
"Don't scream, it's me."
"You..." Wen Ning winked and looked down to see a very blurry outline. She touched it for a while, "What are you doing?"
"It's not a big deal." Xiao Chongyuan raised his body, "Did I wake you up?"
"No, no..." When he raised his head like this, Wen Ning felt something cold on her chest, as if her clothes had been taken off. In the darkness, her little face quickly became warm, and even her throat became dry, "We... that..."
"Don't be nervous, you can continue sleeping if you want."
How could she sleep! When Xiao Chongyuan was about to kiss him again, Wen Ning suddenly stretched out his hand to block him.
"What's wrong?"
"It's very late, and you, you've been working, why not... why not just go to bed?"
"I'm fine, not very tired."
"But..."
"Your face smells so good." Xiao Chongyuan suddenly said this.
Wen Ning was stunned and subconsciously replied: "Huh? Oh, I use new skin care products at night, they are very useful."
Xiao Chongyuan nodded seriously, "I asked my assistant to help pick it out. It seems she has a good taste."
"Oh."
"Do you have anything on your body?"
"No, what's wrong?" Why are they talking about this?
"Why does it smell so good? Especially here..." Xiao Chongyuan said, lowering his head and taking the plump breasts in his mouth.
Wen Ning froze, and pressed his hands on Xiao Chongyuan's shoulders, but couldn't push him down, "Don't..."
Before she could utter any words of resistance, Xiao Chongyuan had already spread her hands on both sides of her body, and his hot lips slid down her chest.
The room was so dark that Wen Ning couldn't see anything. The uneasiness carried by the darkness made the feeling brought by Xiao Chongyuan's lips even more obvious. She was so untouched that she was quickly kissed until her whole body went limp.
Wen Ning always hugged his neck tightly, and occasionally she couldn't help moaning, but she was always very cautious, burying her face in his neck and not daring to raise her head. Because of her caution and timidity, after only doing it twice that night, Xiao Chongyuan let her go and gently held her to sleep.
A beautiful night like the wedding night did not last long. Less than two months after the wedding, Xiao Chongyuan began to prepare for his own hospital.
Although his family was well off, he was reluctant to take over his parents' property, so he was tired of working on his own career. Wen Ning also worked hard to fulfill her duties as a wife and concentrate on taking care of the house, not letting Xiao Chongyuan worry.
However, Xiao Chongyuan was so busy that he almost forgot that he had a newlywed wife at home, so it became increasingly difficult for Wen Ning to see him after a few months of marriage.
One day in the fifth month of marriage, Xiao Chongyuan had not been home for two weeks. She couldn't help but call him that morning. He said he would be back tonight, but he seemed to have broken his promise again...
Wen Ning looked at the large table of food and suddenly felt her nose was sore. She let out a long breath, picked up the chopsticks dejectedly, and stared blankly at the dazzling array of food, not knowing which one to eat.
Just when Wen Ning was hesitant, the elevator dinged. Wen Ning's eyes lit up. She immediately put down her chopsticks and trotted to the entrance. She thoughtfully put her indoor slippers at the door and raised a wise smile. However, when she thought of her braces, she immediately pursed her lips.
Xiao Chongyuan showed a slightly tired smile. He naturally handed the briefcase and car keys to Wen Ning, then changed his shoes and entered the house. He went to the bathroom to take a shower without even looking at the food on the table.
Chapter 1(2)
Fifteen minutes later, Xiao Chongyuan came out again, and the food on the table had been reheated by Wen Ning.
"Did you have a hard day's work?" Wen Ning had nothing to say.
"It's okay." Xiao Chongyuan spoke concisely, feeling that there was no need to talk to Wen Ning about work matters.
"Oh, would you like some red wine?"
"No."
"That's good."Wen Ning poured him a glass of warm water that was eighty percent full, sat across from him, and looked at him expectantly.
In the two weeks they didn't see each other, she learned a few new dishes, and today she showed off her skills in front of Xiao Chongyuan, but he didn't say much from beginning to end, and he didn't even mention a word about the dishes she cooked.
It wasn't until he put down the bowl that Xiao Chongyuan raised his eyes and saw Wen Ning looking at him with a disappointed look. He took out toilet paper and wiped the corners of his lips and asked, "What's wrong?"
"Nothing, have you finished eating?"
"Yeah."
"Then I'll clean it up." Wen Ning smiled, stood up and started to clear away the dishes.
"Thank you, I still have some work to do, so..." Xiao Chongyuan nodded to her and went to the study.
Before Xiao Chongyuan left the study, Wen Ning had already fallen asleep. Just like the wedding night, and like countless previous nights, Wen Ning was woken up by Xiao Chongyuan's kiss after work had come to an end.
"Wait..." Wen Ning blocked his groping hand.
"What's wrong?"
"I changed..."
"What did you change?"
Wen Ning changed into new pajamas, specially shown to him, but Wen Ning waited all night, and he was still working until he fell asleep. Although he was finished working now, he could not see anything in the dark bedroom.
Wen Ning suddenly felt disappointed again, shook his head and said, "It's nothing."
Xiao Chongyuan didn't ask any more questions. He lowered his head to kiss her, but she avoided her. He was slightly unhappy, "What are you hiding from?"
Wen Ning blushed and pursed her lips, "How about we stop kissing from now on?"
Xiao Chongyuan frowned, "Why?"
Wen Ning swallowed, "Because of that... corrector..." She was worried that it would scratch his tongue.
Xiao Chongyuan was stunned for a moment, then smiled helplessly, "Is that why?" No wonder she squirmed when he kissed her.
Xiao Chongyuan rarely had the patience to stop what he was doing and lay on his side next to her, "Why do you always care about this so much? I think this is very good. Correcting your teeth is not a bad thing."
"So ugly..."
"Aning..." Xiao Chongyuan smiled lowly, "Don't think so wildly, I don't think you are ugly."
"Really?" Wen Ning blushed.
"Yeah, don't worry about it, smile more, you look beautiful when you smile."
"Oh..." Wen Ning couldn't help but feel elated.
"So we continue?"
"Yes." Wen Ning smiled sweetly. She was in such a good mood that she actually put her arms around his neck and offered her red lips.
The disappointment just now was swept away, replaced by the sweetness that lingered in his heart. It was precisely because of this occasional tenderness and flutter that Wen Ning always had hope for Xiao Chongyuan, and always felt that when his career stabilized, they would definitely live a good life.
But being immersed in loneliness for a long time made Wen Ning gradually uneasy. She was increasingly unsure of Xiao Chongyuan's feelings for her.
Wen Ning has had a bit of low self-esteem since she was a child. Although she is the daughter of the family, except for her fresh appearance and good figure, she is inferior to her several charming sisters in other aspects. Therefore, she is not very confident in their relationship, and she does not know how to get along with him because of the long separation.
Every time at this time, Wen Ning would always think of that night when he said that she was actually very beautiful when she smiled. This sentence almost became the support for all her subsequent smiles.
Eight months after their marriage, Wen Ning finally got his braces.
After wearing braces for two years, her teeth became straight and white, her cheeks were drawn together, and her chin appeared to be sharpened.
Wen Ning was nearly twenty-three years old at that time. She was already pretty and charming, and she became more refined. The most important thing was that she gained confidence and became more fond of smiling, so her whole feeling changed.
Wen Ning is not an introvert herself. Before, she gradually reduced her interpersonal communication because of wearing braces. Now that this obstacle is gone, she has gradually begun to regain her cheerfulness.
Wen Ning felt that she had become more beautiful, so she should let Xiao Chongyuan know immediately, butXiao Chongyuan, who rarely came home, didn't pay attention to her at all. He only came back once every few weeks. After dinner, he went to the study to work, and he didn't crawl into bed until midnight to wake her up.
There were very few memories of Wen Ning and Xiao Chongyuan, and it seemed that they were only in bed. Although she had gained confidence, she was even more uneasy about their relationship.
As time went by, this uneasiness turned into complaints. Wen Ning felt that Xiao Chongyuan did not regard her as a wife at all, but as a chef, cleaning lady and bed warmer. She persistently wanted to know what his attitude towards her was.
